description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage (RETROSPECTIVE).

LLA Maximum height level: All buildings, structures, and works exceeding 300 metres in height (984.2 feet)

decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans with the approved plans which forms part of this notice.  Location Plan; Transport Impact Assessment; GLA-02L; GLA-03L. Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the communal kitchen or dining room (ground floor) and shall be retained as such, in accordance with the approved plans, in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the proposed plans hereby approved, within 2 months of the date of this decision, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, cycle parking must be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o	Provision of a minimum of FOUR long stay cycle parking spaceso	in an accessible location: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m. o	secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofReason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling.

The refuse and recycling storage hereby approved shall be provided in accordance with the approved details within 1 month of the date of this decision and thereafter maintained unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 4 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Within 1 month of the date of this decision, details of a means of  enclosure along the front boundary of the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The means of enclosure shall be provided in accordance with the approved details within 2 months of receiving written approval by the Local Planning Authority and permanently retained. Reason: In the interests of highway safety and accessibility and to prevent illegal parking on the frontage.
